sin.name: plain-viewer-text
sin.description: A label, title, placeholder or help text in the viewer speaks as the app ('I', 'we') or uses an internal word (row, hook, nudge, engine, compaction, inject, dispatched, ships with, park, dismiss, handled, abandon).
sin.rule: Write every text a person reads in plain, ordinary words: name who acts ('the agent', 'the journal'), say what a control does, and use the house words (Close, Pause, item, to-do).
